raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-AFW-HealthSecurityPhase3",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Delay in recruiting required PIU specialists (accountant, environmental, gender‑based violence, etc.) within the one‑month deadline.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop an accelerated recruitment plan, use interim contracts, and set weekly hiring milestones monitored by the World Bank team.",
      "evidence": "Recipient shall, not later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, appoint... an accountant, a gender‑based violence consultant (Financing Agreement)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Failure to customize existing accounting software for project bookkeeping within three months.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage an IT vendor before effectiveness date, allocate dedicated budget, and conduct bi‑weekly progress reviews against a detailed work plan.",
      "evidence": "customize the existing accounting software... no later than three (3) months after the Effective Date (Financing Agreements for CEMAC, CAR, Cameroon)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Procurement delays caused by weak market competition and limited supplier capacity in fragile settings.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct early market engagement, adopt flexible procurement methods, and provide capacity‑building for local suppliers to broaden competition.",
      "evidence": "Procurement Risks include delays, governance issues, weak contract management, and limited market competition in fragile settings (Section IV.B)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "High fiduciary risk – overall financial management (FM) residual risk rated Substantial for all implementing agencies.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement FM capacity upgrades, update FM manuals, recruit external auditors, and conduct quarterly internal audits with World Bank supervision.",
      "evidence": "The overall FM residual risk rating is assessed as Substantial... for CEMAC, Cameroon, CAR, Chad, and RoC (Section IV.B)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Environmental impacts from construction, laboratory waste and hazardous material handling.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare site‑specific ESMPs, follow the Umbrella ESF, train staff on waste segregation, and monitor compliance through regular audits.",
      "evidence": "Potential impacts include waste, dust, emission, occupational health and safety, and hazardous material disposal (Section D. Environmental and Social)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment (SEA/SH) risks linked to expanded community health workforce.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct GBV and SEA/SH risk assessments, develop Action Plans, recruit dedicated GBV specialists, and train all staff on reporting protocols.",
      "evidence": "Overall project SEA/SH risks are substantial; PIUs will prepare GBV and SEA/SH risk assessments and Action Plans (Section on SEA/SH)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Political instability and conflict in Cameroon, CAR and Chad disrupting service delivery and project activities.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement flexible implementation schedules, develop security risk assessments, maintain contingency funds, and coordinate closely with local authorities and UN agencies.",
      "evidence": "Political instability... may disrupt service delivery (Cameroon appraisal); ongoing conflict in CAR and Chad noted throughout the document."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Climate‑related floods and extreme weather damaging health facilities and surveillance infrastructure.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Design all facility upgrades to climate‑resilient standards, incorporate flood‑risk mapping, and install solar‑powered backup systems.",
      "evidence": "Seasonal floods... raise disease risk; climate change contributes to 50% of natural disasters (Regional Context)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Insufficient domestic financing jeopardizing long‑term sustainability of health security investments.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Support integration of health security into national budgets, develop Medium‑Term Expenditure Frameworks, and explore public‑private partnership pilots.",
      "evidence": "Securing financial sustainability... will be supported to integrate health security into national budgeting processes (Sustainability section)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Weak cross‑border coordination leading to delayed detection and response to outbreaks.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen the Regional Coordination Committee (RCC), formalize MoUs with neighboring states, and conduct regular joint simulation exercises.",
      "evidence": "Regional cross‑border collaboration is essential; RCC will meet regularly and support routine investigations/simulations (Section II.C)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "High turnover or capacity gaps among PIU staff causing implementation delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Offer retention incentives, implement continuous professional development, and maintain a pool of standby qualified personnel.",
      "evidence": "PIUs will be staffed with specialists; risk of questionable expenditures in remote areas noted (Cameroon FM assessment)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Delays in achieving laboratory accreditation (SLIPTA) reducing detection capacity.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide targeted technical assistance, set phased accreditation milestones, and monitor progress through quarterly lab performance reports.",
      "evidence": "Participating Countries with project‑supported laboratories have achieved a 3‑star rating or higher during a SLIPTA audit (Indicators)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Gender gap in epidemiology and veterinary training limiting workforce effectiveness.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement gender‑targeted recruitment, set minimum female participation quotas in training programs, and provide flexible learning formats.",
      "evidence": "Women remain underrepresented; project aims for at least 10% increase in female epidemiologists (Gender section)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Security threats to staff operating in conflict‑affected or IDP‑hosting areas.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop and implement Security Risk Assessments and Security Management Plans, provide security training, and secure insurance for high‑risk travel.",
      "evidence": "PIUs will prepare a Security Risk Assessment (SRA) and Security Management Plan (SMP) (Section on Security)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Delays in finalizing the MoU between CEMAC and WOAH, affecting animal health coordination.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set a firm deadline, assign a liaison officer, and monitor progress through monthly coordination meetings.",
      "evidence": "Recipient shall, no later than ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, enter into a MoU with WOAH (Financing Agreement)."
    }
  ]
}
